titulo_seo: La Virage Club — Rally sponsorship, rights and production
descripcion_seo: We sell rally sponsorship, tickets, hospitality and merchandising, and produce the activations. For organisers and brands. On results.

secciones.titulo: We sell what a rally is worth.
secciones.subtitulo: And make sure it lives up to it.
secciones.texto: Sponsorship, rights and production for rally organisers and brands.
secciones.nota: We work on results: an agreed percentage of what we sell.

items.texto: Make your event earn what it's worth.
Get into rallying with more than a logo on a door.
We sell the sponsorship, tickets, hospitality and merchandising of your event. We take an agreed percentage of what sells.
Commissioned events, brand activations and services for clubs and organisers. Whatever gets sold, we build.

items.titulo: We sit down and take stock
items.texto: Of everything you have: the event, the crowd, the spaces, the dates. Everything that's worth something and isn't being sold today.
We turn that inventory into packages a brand understands and can buy: sponsorship, hospitality, tickets, merchandising and activations.

items.titulo: We sell it and we produce it
items.texto: We go out and sell it. And whatever sells, we build ourselves, so what's promised to the brand actually shows up on race weekend.

items.titulo: We get paid when you do
items.texto: To start with, we work on results: we take an agreed share of what we sell.

secciones.titulo: Tell us what you've got and we'll tell you what can be **sold**.
